summary: NEW ROOT ENTRY, PROVISIONAL. Surface root ṭvz follows the assigned token mṭavzo and preserves source v. No etymology is established.
Only feminine mṭavzo is attested. Active Preterit/Infectum bases, an active sense, other person/number forms and any Detransitive Infectum are unknown and have not been reconstructed.

Hiya mṭavzo predicates a state; subsequent clauses describe the loss of three children and her lovers. The German 'wie erstarrt' supports a stunned state, without proving literal immobility or a separate event of becoming paralysed.

The consonant pattern and feminine ending permit provisional II Detransitive Preterit filing. A lexical adjective remains possible, so this entry must remain visibly provisional until form and category are checked.
